name: tapestry
description: Long-term memory for Claude Code: facts that come to mind when they matter. Draws the lasting facts from each conversation, recalls what bears on each prompt with honest match and belief labels, and keeps each project's memories in their own topic.

judge.title: Which model draws facts
judge.description: In the background, after a session ends, a model draws the lasting facts a conversation taught. auto: nothing is sent. claude: each ended conversation, with the memories nearest it, is sent to Claude (Haiku) through the Claude Code login you already use. claude-api: the same, through the Claude API with the key in ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, billed to that key. jev: TypeSafe's Jev model checked conflicts between memories, which Tapestry no longer does, so with jev nothing is drawn and conversations wait. none: nothing leaves your machine, and only what the agent notes is remembered.

jev_key.title: Vercel AI Gateway key for Jev
jev_key.description: Only used if Jev is the judge, or if the choice above is auto. Needs paid gateway credits.
